title: Parrot 2026 first-quarter business
excerpt: Q1 2026 revenue was EUR 27.9m, up 52% at current exchange rates; professional micro-UAV revenue was EUR 21.3m, up 102%, while critical-infrastructure solutions revenue was EUR 6.6m, down 16%. The group said it was slightly profitable and did not consume cash in the quarter.
summary: Primary issuer release dated 2026-05-20. It reports the ANAFI UKR ramp, institutional deliveries, BLUE UAS and NSPA procurement access, component lead-time pressure, a subscription transition at PIX4D, slight quarterly profitability, and no quarterly cash consumption. It does not provide a full balance sheet, diluted-share bridge, customer concentration, or order values.
